data.long_meaning: Ojukwu is an Igbo name, originating from Nigeria, which means 'God's gift'. It is a name of reverence and acknowledgement of divine intervention and blessings. The name Ojukwu carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Ojukwu usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.meaning: אוקווקו - שמו של נוצרי איגבו ניגרי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוקווקו הוא שם נוצרי איגבו ניגרי, המשמש לעתים קרובות ככינוי או תואר לאלוהים, ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא גדול' או 'הוא גדול'. השם הוא תרכובת של המילים 'אוקו' שפירושה 'אלוהים' ו'וקו' שפירושו 'גדול'.

in_greek.name: Ότζουκβου
in_greek.meaning: Ότζουκβου - Χριστιανικό όνομα Ιγκμπό από τη Νιγηρία

in_latin.name: Ojukwu
in_latin.meaning: Ojukwu - Christian Igbo name from Nigeria
in_latin.long_meaning: Ojukwu is a Christian Igbo name from Nigeria, often used as an epithet or description of God, meaning 'God is great' or 'He is great'. The name is a compound of the words 'Oko' meaning 'God' and 'Okwu' meaning 'great'.

in_english.name: Ojukwu
in_english.meaning: Ojukwu - A Nigerian Christian name meaning God is great
in_english.long_meaning: Ojukwu is a Christian Igbo name from Nigeria, derived from the Igbo words 'Oko' meaning 'God' and 'Okwu' meaning 'great'. The name signifies greatness and divine power, reflecting the Christian concept of an all-powerful God. Historically, Igbo names often carry significant meanings related to spirituality and community values. In modern usage, Ojukwu remains a popular name among Nigerian Christians, symbolizing faith and reverence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ojukwu is a renowned one in Igbo culture, often given to children as a reminder of the divine origin of their existence. Its meaning resonates deeply with the Igbo people, who attribute their lives and accomplishments to divine providence. This name is not only a matter of personal pride, but also a source of communal identity and belonging for those who bear it. Historically, it has been borne by several notable figures in Igbo history, including Chukwuemeka Odumegwu Ojukwu, a renowned military leader and political figure in Nigeria.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Ojukwu lies in its affirmation of faith in God and acknowledgment of the role of divine intervention in one's life. By giving thanks to God for the gift of their existence, those with the name Ojukwu are reminded to live in a way that honors and respects the divine. The name also serves as a reminder of the potential for greatness and achievement that comes from receiving God's blessings. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Ojukwu reflects the deeply held belief in the Igbo people that the divine plays a central role in their lives and their destinies.
